healer.no_public_base: Treeleaf describes itself as an all-digital sangha with no physical zendo; its founder lives in Tsukuba, Japan, but that is his home, not a centre's base.

create.name: Treeleaf Sangha
create.bio:
Treeleaf Sangha, also called Treeleaf Zendo, is a Soto Zen community that has met entirely online since 2006. It was set up for people who cannot get to a Zen centre in person, whether because of illness, distance, caring duties or work, and it aims to offer everything a local sangha would: sitting together, retreats, ceremonies, study and contact with a teacher. Its founder, Jundo Cohen, received Dharma Transmission from Gudo Wafu Nishijima in the Niwa-Nishijima line, and a group of priests he has authorised now teach alongside him.

The heart of the practice is shikantaza, or just sitting, as taught by Eihei Dogen. Members join live on Zoom for a weekly zazenkai on Friday evenings (US time), a European Sunday morning sitting, and a three-hour monthly zazenkai with a Dharma talk led by Jundo; each session is streamed and kept on YouTube, so anyone can sit along later. There is also a discussion forum, an autumn Ango practice period with the chance to receive the precepts, a book club, and a beginners' section with a twenty-two-part talk series and short teachings on core Buddhist ideas.

free_resources.title: Treeleaf Weekly Zazenkai
free_resources.description: A live Zoom sitting each Friday evening (US time) with a short ceremony, two periods of zazen and walking meditation, then informal tea. A Sunday morning version suits people in Europe.

free_resources.title: Treeleaf Monthly Zazenkai
free_resources.description: A three-hour online sitting once a month, with chanting, several rounds of zazen, a Dharma talk by Jundo Cohen and a short question time. It is streamed and recorded, so it can be followed afterwards.

free_resources.title: Treeleaf Basic Zazen Instructions
free_resources.description: A downloadable guide to sitting shikantaza at home: posture, breath and attitude, in the sangha's own words.

free_resources.title: Beginner's Place
free_resources.description: A starting point for newcomers, with a series of video talks on just sitting, short teachings on basic Buddhist ideas, a Zen glossary and a reading list.
